checks.name: single_factor_and_parameter_identity
checks.detail: MeasurementOnlyCalibrator calls nn.Module.__init__ and reuses original.predictor and original.targets. It adds no parameter, tensor initialization or RNG call. The prediction is returned unchanged and only the gates returned to fusion are detached. Existing calibrator.predictor state paths and trained full_reference_targets are retained. A stub-only CPU interface check verified predictor/target object reuse, unchanged prediction object and invocation of gates.detach; this was not a Torch numerical test.

checks.name: gradient_contract
checks.detail: Full and partial fusion use the same calibrator. The inherited predictor consumes context.detach(), and the contribution target remains stopped. Thus the only changed gradient path is retrieval-task-to-predictor through fusion gates. The existing .05 smooth-L1 contribution regression remains the predictor training objective. Relation .1 and identity alignment .1/tau .07 do not add predictor paths. Partial training continues to have no contribution-regression target.

checks.name: CUDA_preflight_coverage
checks.detail: For all three variants, the verifier checks equal initialized state_dict keys and tensor values, seven availability sets times four inference states, and equal full training outputs including the weighted auxiliary loss scalar under matched RNG. It then requires every full task-to-predictor gradient to be None, every predictor tensor to receive finite nonzero weighted regression gradient, and None task gradients for each of all six partial sets. The actual retrieval loss function is unchanged and uses the equal score/features. Parameter and trainable-parameter counts must match across variants.

checks.name: B64_activation_lifetime
checks.detail: The existing trainer performs the full backward before the partial forward and deletes the full output. The new gradient verifier deletes the full values/task/gradient references and clears last_frequency_relation_loss and last_identity_alignment_loss before six partial forwards; only a detached gallery remains. Parent and comparison outputs are released before the gradient probe. No duplicate full training graph is introduced by the M3a wrapper.

checks.name: all_three_real_update_and_reload_barrier
checks.detail: Inherited smoke requires three effective GradScaler optimizer updates within at most six successive attempts, all trainable parameter gradients finite/nonzero on the accepted final update, and exact in-memory strict reload equality. The controller waits for tensor preflight and all three successful smokes before creating training jobs. CPU mocks verified the normal 28 execute-request path and rejection of tensor status failure, smoke status failure, two-update smoke, and strict-reload failure; all four rejected paths issued zero mocked train requests. These are orchestration mocks, not neural execution.

limitations: This is a source-only, same-family provisional review augmented by standard-library AST/hash checks and explicit CPU stubs; it is not independent experimental acceptance.
Requested reviewer model is gpt-6-astra with max reasoning. The actual serving backend/model identity is not independently proven by this review.

No real Torch/NumPy/CUDA model, initialized state_dict parity, numerical forward/loss parity, autograd, AMP update, reload, fresh50 or new installed-GT audit was executed during this review. No dependencies were installed.
No remote host, SSH/SCP payload, deployment helper, external model backend or GPU telemetry was executed. Remote capacity and reference checks remain launch-time gates.

One MSVR development split and seed42 is diagnostic only. M3a must still pass its actual CUDA contract and all three real smokes before any fresh50; completed results and installed-GT audit are required before effectiveness claims.
The audit reference-root is an explicit CLI argument; the authorized invocation must use identity_alignment_m2b_20261004 as stated by the plan.
